title: Datadog (DDOG) Grows Revenue by Over 30% as AI Demand Accelerates
excerpt: Janus Henderson Investors, an investment management company, released its “Forty Fund” Q2 2025 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here....
content_html:
Attiya Zainib

Mon, August 3, 2026 at 11:32 AM EDT 3 min read

Janus Henderson Investors, an investment management company, released its "Forty Fund" Q2 2025 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. The Fund returned 19.00% in the second quarter of 2026, outperforming the Russell 1000 Growth Index's 16.74% gain as strong stock selection and an overweight position in healthcare supported results. The firm said resilient economic growth, robust corporate earnings, easing geopolitical tensions that pushed crude oil below $75 per barrel, and continued AI investment supported markets, although the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged as inflation remained elevated. It added that AI-related opportunities remain a key driver of its outlook, noting demand for AI computing power is expected to exceed supply for the foreseeable future, while one portfolio holding reported revenue growth of more than 30% year over year, and another has an AI-related contracted orders backlog exceeding $550 billion. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Janus Henderson's Forty Fund highlighted stocks like Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG). Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG) is a cloud monitoring and security company that helps businesses track the performance of their applications, infrastructure, and digital systems. The one-month return of Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG) was 8.39% while its shares traded between $98.01 and $278.75 over the last 52 weeks. On July 31, 2026, Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG) stock closed at approximately $267.97 per share, with a market capitalization of about $98.633 billion.

Janus Henderson's Forty Fund stated the following regarding Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

In the information technology sector, top performers included several companies benefiting from increased AI-related spending. Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG) provides observability and infrastructure monitoring solutions that help AI and cloud-based applications run more efficiently, without downtime or latency issues. Demand for these solutions has continued to grow as more AI workflows move onto the cloud, and Datadog has solidified its market leadership in observability through successful collaborations with significant AI-oriented clients. Revenue grew more than 30% year-over-year in the first quarter, exceeding market expectations. The company also raised guidance as it signaled the potential for continued business acceleration.

投资管理公司 Janus Henderson Investors 发布了“四十基金”2025 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 该基金在 2026 年第二季度的回报率为 19.00%，优于罗素 1000 增长指数 16.74% 的涨幅，原因是强劲的选股和增持医疗保健领域的业绩支持。 该公司表示，尽管由于通胀仍然高企，美联储维持利率不变，但经济增长强劲、企业盈利强劲、地缘政治紧张局势缓解（导致原油价格跌破每桶75美元）以及持续的人工智能投资支撑了市场。 该公司补充称，人工智能相关机会仍然是其前景的关键驱动因素，并指出在可预见的未来，人工智能计算能力的需求预计将超过供应，而一个投资组合的收入同比增长超过30%，另一个投资组合的人工智能相关合同订单积压超过5500亿美元。 此外，请查看该基金的前五名持股，以了解其2026年的最佳选择。

Janus Henderson's Forty Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中重点介绍了 Datadog, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）等股票。 Datadog, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）是一家云监控和安全公司，帮助企业跟踪其应用程序、基础设施和数字系统的性能。 Datadog, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）的一个月回报率为 8.39%，过去 52 周其股价在 98.01 美元至 278.75 美元之间交易。 2026年7月31日，Datadog, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）股票收盘价约为每股267.97美元，市值约为986.33亿美元。

Janus Henderson 的 Forty Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就 Datadog, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）发表了以下声明：

在信息技术领域，表现最好的公司包括几家受益于人工智能相关支出增加的公司。 Datadog, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：DDOG）提供可观测性和基础设施监控解决方案，帮助人工智能和基于云的应用程序更高效地运行，而不会出现停机或延迟问题。 随着越来越多的人工智能工作流程转移到云端，对这些解决方案的需求持续增长，Datadog 通过与重要的人工智能客户的成功合作，巩固了其在可观测性方面的市场领导地位。 第一季度收入同比增长超过30%，超出市场预期。 该公司还提高了指引，因为它表明了业务持续加速的潜力。
